apis.name: API-Football (API-Sports)
apis.why_notable: Largest football/soccer coverage with live scores, fixtures, odds, and standings via RapidAPI or direct.

apis.name: TheSportsDB
apis.why_notable: Free multi-sport database with team logos, events, and player metadata—popular for hobby projects.

apis.name: balldontlie
apis.why_notable: Clean NBA stats API with games, players, teams, and season averages; developer-friendly JSON.

apis.name: NBA Stats API
apis.why_notable: Official NBA stats endpoints used widely for advanced box scores and player tracking data.

apis.name: MLB Stats API
apis.why_notable: Official MLB public stats endpoints for schedules, live games, and detailed baseball statistics.

apis.name: NHL API
apis.why_notable: Official NHL web API for schedules, scores, standings, and team/player data.

apis.name: Ergast F1
apis.why_notable: Classic Formula 1 historical results API; may have successors—verify current host.

apis.name: Jolpica F1
apis.why_notable: Community Ergast-compatible F1 API keeping race results and standings accessible after Ergast changes.

apis.name: Football-Data.org
apis.why_notable: European football competitions, fixtures, and standings with a clear free developer tier.

apis.name: OpenLigaDB
apis.why_notable: German open football league data (Bundesliga etc.) with free unrestricted HTTP access.

apis.name: Sportmonks
apis.why_notable: Commercial football and multi-sport data platform with self-serve plans and solid docs.

apis.name: Sportradar
apis.why_notable: Enterprise sports data leader; may be partner-heavy—verify self-serve access carefully.

apis.name: PandaScore
apis.why_notable: Esports scores, fixtures, and stats for LoL, CS, Dota, and more with developer API.

apis.name: GRID Esports
apis.why_notable: Official-grade esports data and live telemetry APIs used by major titles and broadcasters.

apis.name: OpenDota
apis.why_notable: Free Dota 2 match, player, and pro stats API powered by open data.

apis.name: Steam Web API (Dota/CS)
apis.why_notable: Valve Steam Web API for game schemas, player summaries, and some esports-related endpoints.

apis.name: Riot Games API
apis.why_notable: Official League of Legends, Valorant, and TFT match/summoner APIs with free developer keys.

apis.name: API-Basketball
apis.why_notable: API-Sports basketball coverage including NBA and international leagues.

apis.name: API-NBA
apis.why_notable: NBA-focused API-Sports product for games, standings, and player stats.

apis.name: CollegeFootballData
apis.why_notable: Comprehensive NCAA football stats, recruiting, and play-by-play with free API access.

apis.name: NHL Edge / api-web
apis.why_notable: Duplicate risk with NHL API—consolidate if same endpoints.

apis.name: CricAPI / CricketData
apis.why_notable: Cricket scores and series data—verify current brand (CricAPI vs cricketdata).

apis.name: ESPN Hidden API
apis.why_notable: Unofficial public endpoints—may violate ToS; prefer documented APIs only.

apis.name: SportsDataIO
apis.why_notable: US major leagues fantasy/stats data with trial tiers; verify free_tier carefully.

apis.name: Odds API
apis.why_notable: Sports betting odds from many bookmakers; free monthly quota for developers.

apis.name: API-Tennis
apis.why_notable: Tennis fixtures and results via API-Sports family.

apis.name: SofaScore
apis.why_notable: Likely no public self-serve API—exclude if partner-only.

apis.name: Flashscore
apis.why_notable: Likely no public developer API—exclude if not self-serve.
